verdict_statement: STOCKS_FREE_V10_S0_LAUNCH_REFUSED. The freeze chain, the P0 PIT layer, the frozen signal implementations, the two-key guard, the dry-run hygiene and every boundary discipline verified clean, and the void artifact is judged an honest, disclosed edge-case classification - but the D2 novelty gate, the load-bearing pre-selection screen, did not run as frozen: one of the nine forbidden-ancestor veto entries was silently never measured (dead code, fail-open pass logic) and another was measured on a feature that never reads the ancestor's defining field. A gate that publishes PASS while an entry is NOT_RUN is exactly the 'missing artifact is never an inferred PASS' failure the factory's law forbids. Launch is refused until A1 fixes veto_ratio, re-runs D2 against the frozen exposure definitions, re-applies the selection rubric, and re-freezes; a fresh-context A7 re-verification is then required before either key turns.
